note: This is a specific sub-case of Deligne's broader conjecture program. The Hochschild cohomology conjecture was posed in a private letter in 1993, where Deligne expressed it as a mathematical preference or desire (whether the Hochschild cochain complex should have a natural E₂ operad algebra structure) rather than as a formal conjecture. It was later independently proven by Tamarkin (1998), Kontsevich-Soibelman (2000), McClure-Smith (2002), and others.
